wce.welcome.title: World Copies Everything
wce.welcome.tagline: Every block you change repeats every %s blocks · the pattern follows the whole map.
wce.welcome.empty: Pattern for this world: empty (nothing recorded yet).
wce.help.reset: forgets the pattern; blocks already copied stay
wce.help.verify: fixes stale records in a 16-block radius around you
wce.cmd.pause: Pause on. Nothing is recorded or stamped until /wce resume.
wce.cmd.resume: Copying again. Everything you change goes back into the pattern.
wce.cmd.reset: Pattern cleared. %s edits forgotten. Terrain already copied is left as-is.
wce.cmd.verify.player: verify only runs when a player executes it — it uses the area around you.
wce.cmd.verify.done: Checked a radius of %s. Records corrected: %s.
